OpenAiIntegration.title: OpenAI
OpenAiIntegration.help: Optional AI enhancement for nuanced profiles, shortlist reranking and concise explanations.
OpenAiIntegration.configurationHelp: The API key is encrypted. Cued sends only a small set of taste signals and shortlisted candidates.
OpenAiIntegration.apiKeyHelp: Create an API key in the OpenAI platform. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
OpenAiIntegration.encryptionHelp: Configure CUED_ENCRYPTION_KEY before storing an API key.
OpenAiIntegration.costHelp: Estimate in USD for one uncached refresh per day (about 10k input and 2k output tokens). Every rating is included, so larger profiles can cost more. Cached refreshes should cost less; actual usage also varies by mode.

luna.label: Recommended — GPT-5.6 Luna
luna.description: Best balance for nuanced taste analysis and recommendation ranking. Reasoning is disabled to control cost.

nano.label: Lowest cost — GPT-5 Nano
nano.description: Good for basic profiles and ranking, but explanations may be less nuanced.

fourOMini.label: Economical legacy — GPT-4o Mini
fourOMini.description: A proven, inexpensive choice for structured tasks and existing OpenAI setups.

fiveMini.label: Higher quality — GPT-5 Mini
fiveMini.description: Stronger reasoning for subtle preferences, with higher output costs.

custom.label: Custom model
custom.description: Use another OpenAI model ID. Cost estimates are unavailable for custom models.

modes.off: AI is not called. Recommendations use only Cued's deterministic scoring, so there is no API cost.
modes.conservative: AI reviews the top 8 candidates and contributes 15% of their final ranking. This keeps results close to Cued's deterministic score and uses the fewest AI tokens.
modes.balanced: AI reviews the top 12 candidates and contributes 25% of their final ranking. This is the recommended compromise between nuanced personalization, predictable results and API usage.
modes.enhanced: AI reviews the top 20 candidates and contributes 35% of their final ranking. It can reshape the list more noticeably and discover subtler matches, but uses more API tokens.

errors.invalid: Check the API key, model and mode.
